review_scope: Independent adversarial review of R2 exact pre-implementation contract, inactive model/verifier and runtime acceptance design; no production edits or runtime closure execution.

evidence_checked.manifest: Recomputed canonical JSON files-array SHA256 matches requested root; all 137 individual file hashes match.
evidence_checked.model: Inspected ContextCleanup.lean, claims/types/audit inventory and registered verifier. Ran source_inventory static checks successfully: 28 exact theorem/type/claim entries, audit commands, allowed axiom declarations and two witness names. Did not run clean builds before council authorization.
evidence_checked.verifier: Checks six exact-root reviews, frozen snapshots, active309 anchor report without claiming reproof, two isolated Lean compilations with exact type/axiom output and matching artifacts, then final input/review mutation checks. TCB and excluded implementation surfaces are explicit.
evidence_checked.runtime_plan: Inspected all 33 case predicates and key fault/observer/protocol/full-quota subcases. Plan declares no executable runtime verifier or executed cases; runners and fixture hashes must be frozen before execution.
evidence_checked.baseline: Inspected actual proxy admission/relay/cancellation/finally paths, sql_connections canonical routing, SQL guard timeout policy, Store validation snapshot/history path, CLI request identity, bootstrap interpreter/source identity and readiness paths, Java gateway budget and WorkerCapacity ownership.

contract_assessment: Exclusive proxy lease persists across CLI/Java death; never-connected RESERVED is distinct from attempted CONNECTING. Backend EOF, CancelRequest EOF, timeout and absent incomplete metadata are not cleanup certificates.

Context CLEAN requires established exact backend identity, independent fresh absence and closed transport. Sticky failure plus complete legal COMMIT/Ready(I)/Terminate gate prevents successful publication after failed cleanup work. CLI additionally requires staged result and exact owner/nonce/generations.

Observer reservation has an independent durable entry; current-proxy SO_PEERCRED gate restricts reserved admission. Recorded Linux boot/PID/start identity permits read-only absence checks; pre-key observer uncertainty prevents replacement. Restart ordering does not erase unresolved context ownership to open an observer.

R2 closes implementation-environment and journal-ordering gaps explicitly: managed psycopg interpreter, bounded ordinary canonical SELECT 1 readiness before observer reservation, and a single event-loop owner serializing complete-state journal mutations.
Execution fence is defined on actual completed SQL protocol cycles rather than Parse acceptance. Ordinary SQL semantics and mutation uncertainty remain separate from the new context lane.
limitations: Approval is permission to implement this contract, not evidence that production implements it or that the 28 model obligations have passed the required clean builds.

Lean models guarded observations and a single abstract lease. It does not prove COMMIT/protocol adapter correspondence, parent liveness, observer ownership, SQL/backend/kernel behavior, fsync durability or runtime deadlines. Those remain explicit TCB/runtime obligations.

Pre-key context or observer crash can permanently degrade context availability. No operator override or elapsed-time inference may convert UNKNOWN to CLEAN; prompt automatic restart availability remains open.

15 ordinary live handlers is not a bound on actual ordinary PostgreSQL backend tails. Slot exhaustion can fail context startup and retain UNKNOWN; nominal capacity arithmetic does not guarantee a slot.
All 33 runtime cases are unexecuted. Passing fail-closed safety cases cannot be reported as the full P1 availability exit criterion or universal semantic implementation correspondence.

Synchronous serialized fsync and finite scheduler/OS behavior can delay event-loop timers. Deadline thresholds are policy constants, not universal hard-wall cleanup bounds; ownership must survive delayed cleanup.

commercial_scope.assessment: Implementable safety-first contract with material unresolved availability and performance acceptance; no production/commercial readiness endorsement.
commercial_scope.performance: Three-second work budget includes registration, initialization and full permitted history decoding. CC29 must succeed on all six valid near-256MiB/4096-revision fixtures without quota reduction, early exit or timeout increases before promotion. Three samples establish feasibility only, not p95 or throughput.
commercial_scope.availability: Single context lease plus persistent UNKNOWN may disable advisory work after crash/slot exhaustion; this is operationally significant and must remain visible in product/deployment claims.
commercial_scope.excluded: 4-vCPU/8-GiB target acceptance, warm JVM reuse, end-to-end latency improvement and full P1 completion are not established.
